_doc: Configuration for the pubmed-watcher agent. Edit this file freely — the agent re-reads it on every run. Journal abbreviations follow PubMed's [ta] field. Add/remove journals here without touching the agent prompt.

tier_1_primary_cc: Am J Respir Crit Care Med
journals._tier_1_note: Thorax moved out of Tier 1 per user preference (2026-05-16) — see per_journal_score_override. Eur Respir J kept in Tier 1 as primary respiratory journal.
journals._tier_3_additions_note: Added 2026-05-16 per user feedback: Thorax (moved from Tier 1 per user request), Eur J Pediatr and BMJ Paediatr Open (catch peds-CC papers that don't reach PCCM), Neurosurg Rev (catch neurocrit prognostic modeling). All retained only if they pass tier_3_cc_relevance_gate_criteria. 2026-07-16 gold-standard expansion (all [ta] verified via NCBI esearch): added J Am Med Inform Assoc, JAMIA Open, Cardiol Young, Pediatr Cardiol, Clin Neurophysiol, Ann Thorac Surg, Resusc Plus, Lancet Psychiatry, Sci Rep, Front Med (Lausanne), BMC Nephrol, BMC Anesthesiol — derived from Neel's June curated 'gold standard' picks (clinical informatics/AI, hemodynamic/perfusion monitoring, EEG/neuromonitoring, pediatric-cardiac ICU, resuscitation, nephrology). Broad-scope journals (Sci Rep, Front Med (Lausanne), JAMIA Open, BMC*) admit ONLY papers that pass tier_3_cc_relevance_gate_criteria.

tier_3_cc_relevance_gate_criteria._doc: A Tier-3 paper is retained ONLY if at least one of these is true.

publication_types._include_any_of_doc: Broadened 2026-07-16: 'Journal Article' + non-primary types (Review/Editorial/Letter/Case Reports/Consensus Statement) added so physiological, mechanistic, conceptual, and substantive editorial/letter pieces (common in the gold-standard list) are RETRIEVED. Precision is enforced downstream by the journal whitelist, section topic terms, tier-3 CC-relevance gate, soft_exclude tier-gating, low study_type_score for non-primary types, per_section_max, hard_cap, and max_non_primary_per_digest.
publication_types._soft_exclude_doc: Renamed from soft_exclude_unless_tier_1 on 2026-07-16. Narrative Review / Case Reports / Perspective are dropped unless the journal is Tier 1 OR Tier 2. Editorial and Letter (removed from hard_exclude 2026-07-16) are admitted ONLY when the journal is Tier 1 or Tier 2 AND the paper passes tier_3_cc_relevance_gate_criteria. Total non-primary admits capped by digest.max_non_primary_per_digest.

suppression_rules._doc: Per Q17 — papers matching any of these are dropped before scoring, regardless of journal/PT.

covid_only.rule: Drop if title/abstract is primarily about COVID-19/SARS-CoV-2 AND not a guideline-grade update or sentinel trial
covid_only.rationale: Q17 user pref: 4 years on, low marginal value

surgical_technique_no_cc_outcome.rule: Drop if PT includes surgical-procedure focus (e.g., aortic valve repair, fracture fixation, gallbladder) AND no ICU/CC outcome in primary outcomes or abstract
surgical_technique_no_cc_outcome.rationale: Q17 user pref: surgical-technique papers without CC outcomes

public_health_or_epi_only.rule: Drop if paper is descriptive epidemiology / surveillance / prevalence study with no clinical-care implication discussed

scoring._doc: Updated 2026-05-16 per user-preference Q&A. Observational raised (CC literature often observational-heavy). Pediatric boost +50%. ECMO +30%. PARDS/mech-vent +30%. Society guidelines boosted for SCCM/ESPNIC/ELSO/ATS/PALISI. See topic_boosts and suppression_rules for filters that fire before scoring. 2026-07-16: added study_type_score for Guideline/Review/Editorial/Letter/Case Reports and three topic_boosts (informatics/AI, hemodynamic monitoring, EIT).

per_journal_score_override._doc: Multiplier applied to journal_tier_score for specific journals. 1.0 = no change; <1.0 = deprioritize; >1.0 = boost. Use sparingly — these override the tier baseline.

borderline_journals._doc: Journals user has flagged as 'borderline interesting' — include but flag in digest with a [borderline] tag so user can quickly skim and decide.
borderline_journals.Neurosurg Rev: neurocrit prognostic modeling — relevant but not primary CC

topic_boosts._doc: Multipliers applied to include_score AFTER base scoring. Topic detected via MeSH + abstract n-gram match. Pediatric boost stacks with topic boost.

societies: European Society of Paediatric and Neonatal Intensive Care
society_guideline.detection: Match in author affiliations OR title OR abstract phrasing like 'society guideline', 'consensus statement', endorsing society named

informatics_ai_in_cc.detection: Match any ngram in title/abstract OR any mesh term in the paper's MeSH headings

hemodynamic_perfusion_monitoring.detection: Match any ngram in title/abstract OR any mesh term in the paper's MeSH headings

eit_regional_ventilation.detection: Match any ngram in title/abstract OR any mesh term in the paper's MeSH headings

digest._max_non_primary_per_digest_doc: Added 2026-07-16. Caps the number of non-primary-research admits (Editorial + Letter + Case Reports + Perspective + narrative Review) per digest at 4, keeping the highest include_score. Primary research (RCT / Meta-Analysis / Systematic Review / Observational / Multicenter / Guideline / Consensus) is NOT limited by this rule.

borderline_section._doc: Per Q13: capped at 3, listed at very end of digest. Papers that scored within the top-35 but didn't make the 25-cap, OR papers from borderline_journals that passed the CC-relevance gate.

summary_style._doc: Per Q14: title + journal + 1-sentence practice impact ONLY when agent is ≥95% confident the impact claim is supported by the abstract. Otherwise: title + journal + PT only. No speculation, no hedging.
summary_style.format_high_confidence: Title (linked) — Journal, Year, PT. Practice impact: <one sentence backed by explicit abstract evidence>.

practice_changing_flag._doc: Per Q12 + Q19: [⚡ practice-changing] tag at top of digest. Fires only when paper meets at least ONE of the trigger criteria below.

triggers.name: guideline_grade_change
triggers.rule: Practice Guideline OR Consensus Development Conference PT, AND abstract explicitly states a new/upgraded/downgraded recommendation

triggers.name: rct_hard_outcome_effect
triggers.rule: RCT PT, sample size adequately powered (state N + outcome power calc), effect size ≥25% relative change on a hard outcome (mortality, ventilator-free days, AKI requiring RRT, LOS in ICU, neurologic outcome), CI excludes null

triggers.name: multicenter_cohort_overturns_or_confirms_rct
triggers.rule: Multicenter Study + Observational, large N, finding aligns or conflicts with a recent landmark RCT (agent must cite the RCT in the impact sentence)

preference_profile._doc: seed_examples is a list of PMIDs you previously found interesting — provided manually. learned_profile is updated by the agent each run from [star] and [skip] tags in prior digests. Leaving seed_examples empty means v1 falls back to journal-tier + study-type ranking with neutral preference_match (0.5).
preference_profile.seed_examples_source: Curated from /Users/neel/Downloads/Claude Sandbox/Clinical/M&M/03_literature/literature_review.md (M&M curated top-20, April 2026), PARDS PubMed export (.nbib, 2021), and targeted searches for recent pediatric ECMO/sedation RCTs. All PMIDs verified via PubMed MCP get_article_metadata 2026-05-16.
preference_profile.seed_examples_2026_07_source: 29 seeds appended 2026-07-16 from Neel's June 2026 curated 'gold standard' digest picks (provenance: resolved June pubmed-watcher digests). All 29 PMIDs re-verified via pubmed_eutils.py fetch on 2026-07-16 — each resolves to a real 2026 (one 2025) article. Span: ECMO/ECLS + informatics (OMOP), respiratory/ARDS + EIT, shock/sepsis, neuro/EEG, hemodynamic/perfusion monitoring (VExUS, capillary refill, echo), pediatric-cardiac, renal, and physiology-forward editorials/letters/reviews. These encode Neel's stated interests in clinical informatics/AI, hemodynamic monitoring, EIT/regional ventilation, and EEG/neuromonitoring.

learned_profile._doc: positive_*/negative_* are the ACTIVE distributions preference_match uses (unioned with seed_examples). gold_seed_distribution is a PROTECTED floor bootstrapped 2026-07-16 from the 76-article June gold-standard corpus (titles + finding snippets; computed by scratchpad/compute_gold_profile.py, reproducible). The per-run writeback MUST merge new [star]/[skip] tag signal INTO positive_*/negative_* AND always re-union gold_seed_distribution — it must NEVER blank positive_* back to {} when a run has no new tags.
